meta.title: Budget-airline (LCC) nonstop route matrix from Bangkok
meta.scope_note: Nonstop from DMK or BKK only. Thai domestic excluded. Times local; schedule tables are Oct 2026 (pre-winter) unless a note gives winter times; frequencies estimated from 2LNR next-7-service-days table.

status_legend.suspended: currently suspended; tentative restart on start date
status_legend.charter: scheduled charter / charter-type flight numbers (often sold via tour agents)
status_legend.not_operating: listed somewhere but no flights scheduled
status_legend.not_in_schedule: listed by 2LNR, no flights in next 7 service days

meta.google_flights_finding: Google Flights shows Thai AirAsia / AirAsia X schedules but 'Total price is unavailable' (no fares) in our checks; Thai Vietjet/VietJet are priced; Thai Lion Air appears only on some routes (e.g. HGH priced) and is missing on others (e.g. PVG). A fare sweep via Google Flights therefore covers VZ/VJ (+ some SL) prices; FD/XJ/SL fares need airasia.com / lionairthai.com (or an OTA) for exact prices.

no_lcc_nonstop.XMN: Xiamen — no in-scope LCC nonstop (only Xiamen Air / Spring Airlines etc.); TG flies from 25 Oct 2026
no_lcc_nonstop.PEK: Beijing — no in-scope LCC nonstop operating (VZ PKX listed but no flights scheduled; FD/SL PKX not in schedule data)
no_lcc_nonstop.HND: Tokyo Haneda — no LCC; use NRT (XJ, VZ)
no_lcc_nonstop.PUS: Busan — no in-scope LCC nonstop found
no_lcc_nonstop.MDL: Mandalay — no in-scope LCC nonstop found
no_lcc_nonstop.BOM/MAA/BLR/COK/CCU/DEL via SL: Thai Lion India: suspended until mid-Dec 2026 (tentative)
